summary: If LDAPS fails with 'SERVER_DOWN ... certificate verify failed (self-signed certificate)', copy the LDAP server certificate to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and run update-ca-trust on every platform gateway instance.
questions: LDAPS certificate verify failed self-signed certificate
Can't contact LDAP server SERVER_DOWN in AAP
How do I make platform gateway trust my LDAP certificate?

answer_card.title: Trust the LDAPS certificate on platform gateway
answer_card.answer_md:
Error: `SERVER_DOWN ... certificate verify failed (self-signed certificate)`

On **every platform gateway instance**:
```bash
cp ldap-server.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/
update-ca-trust
```
